description: Search research publications (journal papers, conference proceedings) linked to EU-funded projects in the CORDIS linked-data knowledge graph. Filter by keyword in the publication title, or scope to a specific project by providing the grant agreement number. Returns publication identifier, full title, DOI (when available), publication date, and the RCN of the parent EU project. Covers 283,000+ journal papers and 92,000+ proceedings papers from Horizon/H2020 research.

limit.description: Maximum number of publications to return (1-20, default 10)

project_id.description: Optional grant agreement number to scope publications to a specific EU project (e.g. "101181585")

query.description: Keyword(s) to search in publication titles (e.g. "machine learning", "cancer therapy", "battery storage")

name: cordis.research.project_publications

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CORDIS — EU Project Publications Search
